title: CSOAI Paid-Entitlement Certificate
description: The signed payload issued to a paying customer on successful settlement. It is a measurement credential, never a certification or conformity assessment. The signing key never appears in the payload: the issuer (the board-attestation key in the operator's secret store) signs canonically-serialized JSON, and the certificate carries the signature, payload SHA-256, and the issuer DID intent. A revocation record (csoai.refund-record/0.1) supersedes the certificate without erasing history.

certificate_id.description: Stable identifier: sha256 of the canonical payload bytes. Cert verifier reads the same canonical form to recompute the id.

issued_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the certificate was issued.

issuer_did.description: The DID of the signing party. The verifier fetches the DID document and resolves the verification method.

subject.description: Who this certificate is issued to.

id.description: CSOAI-side stable id (login email is fine; license id is fine).

email_hash.description: Optional: sha256 of the subject email for privacy-preserving uniqueness. null when the subject is a license id.

entitlement.description: What this certificate unlocks. A sku is an opaque identifier; the entitlements those unlock live in functions/api/_skus.ts.

sku.description: One of the entitlement skus that csoai exposes (e.g. csoai.measurement-card.issuance, csoai.depth-probe, csoai.cert.period).

tier.description: free = no fee · proof = per-call paid · feed = sustained subscription.

issued_via.description: Provenance of issuance. Tells the verifier whether the cert was issued by an automated pipeline or by an operator.

settlement_reference.description: The paddle event id or operator action id that produced the settlement. Required when channel != self_test.

scope.description: What the subject can claim under this cert. Scope is bound to the cert, not the subject, so a refund revokes it cleanly.

items.description: MCP tool name (e.g. mcp_trust, x402_trust) or measurement axis (e.g. safety, governance).

free_calls_per_day.description: Rate limit, null = unlimited under the paid plan.

limits.description: What this cert does NOT enable. Mirror of the entitlement doctrinally, not a marketing claim.

non_certification.description: This cert does not certify conformity, accuracy, or quality. True always; absent means false.

non_promotion.description: Issuance of this cert is not a promotion of the subject's product, service, or character. True always.

non_transferability.description: When true the cert is bound to subject.id and may not be reissued to a third party. Recommended true.

verification.description: How to verify the signature. The DID document is fetched separately; these fields name where and how.

url.description: Free, public verification URL. csoai_verify uses this in its usage line.

payload_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical payload bytes (the bytes that were signed).

sig_ed25519.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload, base64. null only at issuance time before signing (the publisher signs and replaces); never null in a published certificate.
